03382 Yered {yeh'-red}

源自 03381; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Jared 5, Jered 2; 7

雅列 = "下降"
1) 瑪勒列的兒子, 以諾的父親, 塞特的第四代子孫
2) 猶大的子孫, 基多之祖     (#代上 4:17|)
record.edic_text:
03382 Yered {yeh'-red}

from 03381;; n pr m

AV - Jared 5, Jered 2; 7

Jered or Jared = "descent"
1) son of Mahalaleel and father of Enoch in the 4th generation from Seth
2) a descendant of Judah and father of Gedor
